issues.description: The problem statement and UML require the Farm to use a List implemented with an ArrayList for the animals attribute and to initialize it in the no-arg constructor, but the provided solution uses a Set (HashSet) for the animals collection. This is a structural mismatch in the attribute type that could confuse students about which collection type to use and how to initialize it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent. Either update the solution to use List<Animal> and initialize it with a new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor (matching the problem statement/UML), or revise the problem statement/UML to accept a Set implementation (HashSet) and remove the explicit requirement to use ArrayList so students are not constrained to a specific collection type.
